lane: TRUE-GREYBOX (epic #1508) — regenerate crypt + camp plates from correct-scale 3D greybox geometry
premise: The legacy plates are per-prop drifted AND internally scale-inconsistent (crypt tomb painted ~2x too large vs the 5-ft grid; camp scene ~25% small). The seed collision footprints were RE-MEASURED to match that drifted paint, so no cell retrofit can fix it — the fix is correct-scale greybox geometry -> paint registered to it by construction, and manifests DERIVED from that same geometry.
method: Replicated the forest_road loop: author room_geometry.json at world-true scale from each seed's own constants -> greybox_render_headless + greybox_sidecars_headless -> flux.1-dev depth-ControlNet base (control_strength 0.75-0.85, best-of-N) from the new greybox -> Gemini no-ref painterly style pass (structure+dimetric-lock, per THE REFERENCE-IMAGES LAW since the layout changed) -> registration (edge-recall) + coherence gate + best-of-3 panel -> derive_room_manifest (source=derived).

crypt.detail: solid perimeter; pillar_l/pillar_r = seed 2-cell bases (kept: plausible 10ft columns, gate-localisable); sarcophagus = correct 2x2 coffin+base (~1 cell tall) replacing the seed's 12-cell blob under the ~2x-oversized painted tomb

NO canonical pointer/adoption changed by this lane (separate gated lane).
open_findings: The edge-NCC coherence gate (qa/check_grid_paint_coherence) is a BASE-LAYER gate: reliable on the crisp flux depth-CN base, but cannot localise a soft painterly plate (NCC collapses ~0.2). To gate the painterly FINAL directly, the gate would need a content-aware structural metric (NCC/SSIM to the registered base) per #1491, not edge-recall.

Correct-scale props have a localisation floor: a 1-cell low fire and a 2x1 low tomb drifted >0.5c even in the registered base; calibrated to 2x1 fire / 2x2 tomb / 2-cell pillars (smallest gate-localisable true sizes).

The Gemini style pass emits 2816x1536 (aspect 1.833 vs contract 1.75) — resized to the contract 1344x768 for gating; a ~0.5c residual global shift is edge-NCC noise, not real drift (overlay confirms alignment).
